perf.summary: Replace per-k StirlingSecond recomputation with the O(n^2) Bell triangle.
perf.currentCost: Loops k=0..n calling StirlingSecond.Run(n,k,...), and each call is itself an O(n*k) DP over a stackalloc array. Net cost is roughly O(n^3) and it rebuilds the same Stirling table n+1 times.
perf.proposedChange: Use the Bell triangle: stackalloc one row of length n+1, row[0]=prevLast; B(n) via the recurrence row[j] = (row[j-1] + prev[j-1]) % mod. Yields all Bell numbers up to n in O(n^2) time, O(n) space.
perf.rationale: Drops an entire factor of n and removes n+1 redundant full DP reconstructions plus n+1 stackalloc/zeroing passes. Same modular result.
perf.risk: Bell triangle arithmetic is all additions mod mod, no inverses, so it is valid for any mod (broader than current). Need one row buffer of n+1 longs via stackalloc, consistent with house rules.

perf.summary: Defer modular inversion: divide once at the end instead of per loop iteration.
perf.currentCost: Catalan calls MathHelper.ModInverse (ExtGcd, O(log mod)) every k from 2..n; MultisetPermutations calls it once per group but builds factC redundantly. Both interleave O(log mod) inversions into otherwise O(1) steps.
perf.proposedChange: Catalan: accumulate num = prod(n+k) and den = prod(k) mod mod, then result = num * ModInverse(den,mod) % mod once. MultisetPermutations: accumulate the product of all per-group factorials into one denominator, then a single ModInverse.
perf.rationale: Reduces n (resp. k) modular inversions to exactly one, cutting an O(n log mod) loop to O(n) plus one inversion. Shorter dependency chain, less recursion.
perf.risk: Requires den coprime to mod (mod prime), which these prime-mod APIs already assume. Products stay reduced mod mod each step so no overflow beyond existing result*x pattern for mod < 2^31.

perf.summary: Drop the explicit zeroing loop after stackalloc by combining with init, and hoist invariant (i-1)/j multiplier handling.
perf.currentCost: Each does a full `for i<=k: s[i]=0` pass before seeding s[0]=1; the inner DP then reads s[j-1]. The zeroing pass is a separate O(k) sweep over the buffer.
perf.proposedChange: stackalloc then a single init that sets s[0]=1 and s[1..k]=0 in one pass (or use Unsafe.InitBlock-style clear), and in StirlingFirst hoist the loop-invariant (i-1) into a local once per i (already a local via i, but ensure (i-1)%mod isn't recomputed). Reuse one cleared buffer.
perf.rationale: Removes a redundant pass over the working set (better cache behavior) and avoids recomputing invariants; minor but free.
perf.risk: Must preserve s[0] reset to 0 inside the i-loop (the recurrence relies on s[0]=0 for i>=1 except the seed). Keep that semantics exactly.
